title: Alphabet Turtle Dreamscape
description: A surreal painting depicts a young Black woman with a large afro of swirling letters and one glowing white eye, her neck merging into the body of a giant turtle. The turtle's shell is composed of colorful alphabet tiles, while smaller turtles fly toward a large dark turtle silhouette in a sunset sky above a desert landscape.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at sunset with a giant turtle whose shell is made of colorful square alphabet tiles. A young Black woman with a large afro composed of floating letters emerges from the turtle's head, she has one glowing white eye. Smaller turtles fly across the orange and purple sky toward a large dark turtle silhouette. Letters and footprints float in the air, warm cinematic lighting, detailed painterly style.
